title: Inside Rocket Evolution: Why Early Rockets Were Thinner Than Dimes
description:
Witness the incredible Rocket Evolution from 1926’s naked metal pipes to the 36-story Saturn V and the laser-upgraded Artemis. How did we go from "metal pencils" that collapsed on the pad to machines thinner than a dime that survived the vacuum of space?

Explore the physics of structural architecture where fuel makes up 90% of a rocket's mass. From the asymmetric Space Shuttle to the 8.8 million pounds of thrust powering our return to the Moon, this is the story of how we conquered gravity through trial, failure, and radical engineering.

🔔 Subscribe for daily strange science: https://www.youtube.com/@proofofwonderscience?sub_confirmation=1
▶️ Watch more Proof of Wonder Shorts: https://www.youtube.com/@proofofwonderscience/shorts

Which era of rocket design do you think looks the most "alien"?
